name: Potable water storage and hot water system
description: Potable water is bunkered to the installation, stored in dedicated tanks and distributed through domestic pipework with chlorination; hot water is provided by calorifiers where fitted. The Marine Safety Forum guidance gives water-quality limits, tank management and disinfection practice for offshore installations. Primary source: https://www.marinesafetyforum.org/wp-content/uploads/2018/08/MSF-Guidance-Delivering-Quality-PotWater-to-Offshore-Installations-18th-July-2103.pdf
aliases: Potable water storage and hot water system

specifications.metric: Potable water storage tank and domestic  — Free chlorine at point of delivery to vessel
specifications.basis: The free chlorine concentrations in water must be maintained above 0.2ppm at the point of delivery to the vessel

specifications.metric: Potable water storage tank and domestic  — Installation disinfection maintenance range
specifications.basis: Can the installation demonstrate that it has maintained chlorination levels between 0.2ppm and 0.5ppm over a prolonged period of time?

specifications.metric: Potable water storage tank and domestic  — Good-practice maximum storage before disposal
specifications.basis: Good practice would be to dispose of all water in such tanks after 14 days continuous storage

specifications.metric: Potable water storage tank and domestic  — Super-chlorination concentration
specifications.basis: In order to achieve 50ppm (50mg/l) disinfectant in solution ... The disinfected water at 50ppm should be allowed to remain in the whole system for at least 1 hour

specifications.metric: Potable water storage tank and domestic  — Coliforms / E.coli / Enterococci limit
Potable water storage tank and domestic  — Chlorides limit
Potable water storage tank and domestic  — Total viable count at 22 degC / 37 degC
specifications.basis: In the UKCS, a workable limit of 300cfu/ml at 22 oC and 100cfu/ml at 37 oC is regarded as acceptable

specifications.metric: Potable water storage tank and domestic  — Hydrocarbons limit
specifications.basis: Hydrocarbons <10 ppb ... Less than 10ppb is the stated limit value as this is generally the limit of detection

specifications.metric: Potable water storage tank and domestic  — Legionella limit
Price — Raw water rough cost estimate
specifications.basis: A very rough estimate of water costs can be made by assuming $2 per 1000 gal ($0.5 per metric ton) - Chemical Engineering Design 2nd ed., ©2013, dollar year not separately stated; dollar year 2013.
Demineralized water typically costs about double the price of raw water; dollar year 2013.
